one_line: A Tamil Ainnurruvar guild merchant based at the camphor port of Barus in 1088 CE, navigating Srivijaya trade and diaspora life.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but sturdy build from sea travel and port life.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp dark-brown eyes, a small horizontal sacred ash line on the forehead, default expression calm and calculating with a slight confident half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied back into a modest, low knot at the nape, smoothed with oil; no helmet, but a narrow off-white cotton head-cloth (thin turban band) wrapped once around the head and knotted at the back, leaving the top mostly visible.
appearance.costume: He wears a deep indigo-dyed cotton angavastram-style upper cloth draped over both shoulders and pinned under the right arm, covering the torso modestly, paired with a knee-to-ankle-length off-white cotton veshti (dhoti) wrapped and pleated to the front with a thin maroon border; under the drape, a simple short-sleeved off-white cotton tunic is visible at the neckline; his waist is cinched with a practical brown leather belt holding a small cloth pouch and keys; on his feet are plain dark-brown leather sandals suitable for docks; he wears a simple gold stud in each ear, a thin gold chain with a small leaf-shaped pendant, and a few copper and brass bangles on his right wrist; over his left shoulder hangs a sturdy, slightly worn, un-dyed cotton shoulder bag with visible stitching, and his overall fabrics show subtle handloom texture without ornate royal decoration.
appearance.signature: A long, narrow palm-leaf bundle ledger bound with red cotton string and housed in a rectangular dark-wood case with carved edges, carried in his left hand or tucked under his arm, often accompanied by a short reed stylus tucked into his belt.

ref_desc: A lean Tamil merchant in deep indigo upper cloth, off-white dhoti with maroon border, off-white tunic, leather belt and sandals, black hair in a low knot with a narrow head-cloth, gold studs, palm-leaf ledger in wooden case, and warm medium-brown skin.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a Tamil Ainnurruvar merchant in Barus around 1088 CE: a lean man in his late 20s with an oval face, warm medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, dark-brown eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing a small horizontal sacred ash line on his forehead and keeping a calm, calculating expression with a slight confident half-smile. His thick black hair is oiled and tied into a modest low knot at the nape, wrapped with a narrow off-white cotton head-cloth band knotted at the back. Dress him in historically grounded South Indian merchant attire: a deep indigo-dyed cotton upper cloth draped over both shoulders and under the right arm, modestly covering the torso; beneath it a simple short-sleeved off-white cotton tunic at the neckline; a long off-white cotton dhoti (veshti) with a thin maroon border, wrapped and pleated to the front down to the ankles; a brown leather belt at the waist holding a small cloth pouch and keys; plain dark-brown leather sandals on his feet. Add modest jewellery: small gold studs in both ears, a thin gold chain with a small leaf-shaped pendant, and a few copper and brass bangles on his right wrist. Give him a sturdy un-dyed cotton shoulder bag with visible stitching hanging over his left shoulder, suggesting sea-trade travel gear. His signature prop is a long, narrow palm-leaf ledger bundle in a dark-wood rectangular case with carved edges, carried in his left hand or tucked under his arm, with a short reed stylus tucked into his belt. Use a palette of deep indigo, off-white, maroon, dark brown, and his warm medium-brown skin tone, and show him in neutral standing poses that clearly display his face, hair, full costume, sandals, shoulder bag, and the palm-leaf ledger case from multiple angles.
